label: sub_034_ecology_02
text: We just saw the Terastal energy reading from one\nof the black crystals disappear a moment ago.\r\nDo you know anything about that?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_03
text: Whaaat?! You battled the Pokémon there?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_04
text: *sigh*\nI thought I made it clear that it was too risky.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_05
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well, in any case, I’m just glad that you’re\nOK, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_06
text: Your efforts have helped us come to understand\nthe laws governing Terastal energy emissions.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_07
text: Thanks for your help. I’m sending you something\nas a thank-you gift.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_08
text: Still, even after all this, it seems that the amount\nof energy being emitted is slowly growing.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_09
text: That means we may continue to see more black\ncrystals appear in the future.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_10
text: I don’t imagine you’ll listen to me even if I try to\nstop you, so I won’t be too firm with you...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_11
text: but please continue to be careful out there![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sub_034_ecology_12
text: Ah, by the way, Director Clavell will be madder\nthan a rampaging Primeape if he finds out, so\r\nlet’s keep this between us two![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
